'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Three [[Pakistan Army|Pakistani soldiers]] and 19 [[Pakistani Taliban|Taliban]] insurgents are killed in shootouts in [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-shootouts-soldiers-militants-killed-northwest-541ad3bf572096f0e6c3578987dfad67 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Argentine debt restructuring]]
**[[Economy of Argentina|Argentina]]'s [[country risk]] index, measured by the [[JPMorgan GBI-EM Index]], briefly drops to 444 points, its lowest level since 2018, before closing at 561 points due to technical adjustments linked to upcoming [[Bond (finance)|bond]] payment amid improved [[market sentiment]] driven by cooling [[inflation]] and signs of economic recovery. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-country-risk-plummets-lowest-level-since-may-2018-2025-01-07/ (Reuters)]
*International flights resume from [[Damascus International Airport]] in [[Syria]] for the first time since the [[fall of the Assad regime]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250107-international-flights-resume-at-damascus-airport (France 24)]
* The merger of the providers of [[stock photography]] [[Getty Images]] and [[Shutterstock]], by the acquisition of the latter by the former, is announced. [https://apnews.com/article/shutterstock-getty-images-e883ef74736e016315417c758ab17093 (AP News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 California wildfires]]
**[[January 2025 Southern California wildfires]]
***An exceptional [[Santa Ana winds|Santa Ana]] [[2025 Southern California windstorm|wind event]] reaching hurricane-force in some locations in [[Southern California|southern]] [[California]], [[United States]], cause multiple [[Power outage|power outages]] and [[Wildfire|wildfire outbreaks]], including a rapidly-spreading >2,900 acre [[2025 Palisades wildfire|wildfire]] in [[Los Angeles County, California|Los Angeles County]] which causes several [[Burn|burn injuries]] and forces 30,000 people to evacuate. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/01/07/weather/california-windstorm-fire-los-angeles-climate/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/weather/wildfires/live-blog/live-updates-pacific-palisades-wildfire-rapidly-grows-california-rcna186685 (NBC News)]
*[[2025 Tibet earthquake]]
**At least 126 people are killed and dozens of others are injured when a magnitude {{M|w|7.1}} ({{M|s|6.8}}) earthquake strikes [[Tingri County]], [[Shigatse]], [[Tibet Autonomous Region]], [[China]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/7/earthquake-hits-tibets-shigatse-city-tremors-felt-in-nepals-kathmandu (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/china-nepal-tibet-earthquake-himalayas-ca21bd4848209370b9eebcaf107208df (AP)]
*A [[light aircraft]] crashes near [[Rottnest Island]], [[Western Australia]], killing the pilot and two [[Tourism in Australia|tourists]] from [[Danes|Denmark]] and [[Swiss people|Switzerland]] while injuring three other passengers. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/swiss-danish-tourists-among-three-dead-australian-plane-crash-2025-01-08/ (Reuters)]
*Thirteen [[Cuban Revolutionary Armed Forces|Cuban soldiers]] go missing after explosions at an arms and ammunition depot in [[Holguín Province]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/08/americas/cuban-soldiers-missing-explosion-ammo-depot-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[HMPV outbreak in East Asia (2024–present)|HMPV outbreak in East Asia]]
**[[India]] confirms their first cases of the [[human metapneumovirus]] disease. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hmpv-human-metapneumovirus-india-cases-confirmed-symptoms/ (CBS News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Denmark–United States relations]], [[Proposals for the United States to purchase Greenland]], [[Panama–United States relations]]
**[[President-elect of the United States|U.S. president-elect]] [[Donald Trump]] refuses to rule out using [[United States Armed Forces|military]] force to take control of [[Greenland]] and the [[Panama Canal]], declaring U.S. control of both to be "vital to American [[national security]]". [https://apnews.com/article/trump-biden-offshore-drilling-gulf-of-america-fa66f8d072eb39c00a8128a8941ede75 (AP)]
**Trump's son [[Donald Trump Jr.]] makes a personal visit to Greenland weeks after Trump announced that "ownership and control of Greenland is an absolute necessity". In response to the visit, [[Prime Minister of Denmark|Danish prime minister]] [[Mette Frederiksen]] states that "Greenland belongs to the [[Greenlanders]]". [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5yv10knyd9o (BBC News)]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Panama)|Panamanian foreign minister]] Javier Martínez-Acha asserts that only [[Panamanians]] operate the Panama Canal and that its sovereignty is non-negotiable, dismissing Trump's claims that [[China]] operates the canal and his suggestion of potential [[U.S. military]] action to [[United States invasion of Panama|regain control]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/panama-tells-trump-canal-sovereignty-is-non-negotiable/a-71243119 (DW)]
*[[Hungary–United States relations]]
**The [[U.S. Treasury]] imposes [[United States sanctions|sanctions]] on [[Cabinet of Hungary|Hungarian cabinet]] minister [[Antal Rogán]] for alleged [[Corruption in Hungary|corruption]], accusing him of using his position to secure financial benefits for himself and [[Politics of Hungary|political]] allies. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-imposes-sanctions-senior-hungarian-official-suspected-corruption-2025-01-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudan–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] accuses the [[Rapid Support Forces]] of committing [[genocide]] in [[Sudan]] during the [[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|ongoing civil war]] and imposes sanctions on the group's leader [[Hemedti]]. [https://apnews.com/article/biden-sudan-genocide-7a0d20f857af3fd428750cf2dfd231ae (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Venezuelan political crisis]]
**[[Venezuelan opposition]] leader [[Edmundo González]] reports the kidnapping of his son-in-law Rafael Tudares by masked men in [[Caracas]], as political tensions persist following González's contested claim of victory in [[2024 Venezuelan presidential election|the country's July presidential election]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/7/venezuelan-opposition-candidate-claims-son-in-law-has-been-kidnapped (Al Jazeera)]
*Former [[Cambodia]]n [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] [[Parliament of Cambodia|lawmaker]] [[Lim Kimya]] is shot dead by a [[Drive-by shooting|gunman on a motorcycle]] in [[Bangkok]], [[Thailand]]. [[Politics of Cambodia|Cambodian officials]] deny allegations of involvement in Lim's death. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/jan/08/former-cambodian-opposition-politician-shot-dead-in-bangkok-reports (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Lebanon]] approves the [[extradition]] of [[Abdul Rahman Yusuf]], the son of late [[Egyptians|Egyptian]] ''[[ulama]]'' [[Yusuf al-Qaradawi]], to the [[United Arab Emirates]] following his detention on December 28 after returning from Syria. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanon-extradite-son-late-senior-muslim-cleric-al-qaradawi-uae-pms-office-says-2025-01-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mauritius]] issues an [[arrest warrant]] for former [[Ministry of Finance and Economic Development (Mauritius)|finance minister]] [[Renganaden Padayachy]] over alleged [[embezzlement]] involving the disbursement of [[Mauritian rupee|Rs.]] 45 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]1 million) from the Mauritius Investment Corporation. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mauritius-issues-arrest-order-against-former-finance-minister-local-newspaper-2025-01-07/ (Reuters)]
*Two people are killed and one is injured in a [[mass shooting]] at Zahnradfabrik Hanel in [[Bad Friedrichshall]], [[Baden-Württemberg]], [[Germany]]. The perpetrator is arrested. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-two-dead-after-shooting-in-baden-w%C3%BCrttemberg/a-71242451 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Venezuelan political crisis]]
**[[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan president]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] announces [[Political prisoners in Venezuela|the arrest]] of seven [[International reactions to the 2024 Venezuelan presidential election|foreign individuals]], whom he accuses of planning terrorist acts to disrupt his upcoming inauguration, with [[National Bolivarian Armed Forces of Venezuela|security forces]] conducting a [[Venezuela|nationwide]] deployment. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/8/venezuelas-maduro-says-us-nationals-among-group-of-mercenaries-detained (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Death and state funeral of Jimmy Carter]]
**The body of former [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Jimmy Carter]] arrives in [[Washington, D.C.]] for a three-day mourning period, including a [[lying in state]] at the [[United States Capitol|Capitol]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/jimmy-carter-lie-state-us-capitol-before-funeral-2025-01-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Libyan crisis (2011–present)|Libyan crisis]]
**The [[House of Representatives (Libya)|House of Representatives]] of [[Libya]] approves a national reconciliation and [[transitional justice]] law aimed at unifying the country after over a decade of conflict. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/libyas-eastern-parliament-approves-transitional-justice-law-unity-move-mps-say-2025-01-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[John Mahama]] is sworn in for a second term as [[President of Ghana]], having previously served as president from 2012 to 2017. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ghanas-mahama-returns-president-facing-old-problems-2025-01-07/ (Reuters)]
